usageBackends.label: Claude
usageBackends.source: Read from Claude Code’s status line while a Terminal agent works. Agent SDK agents run on an API key, which has no usage windows: they read nothing.

usageBackends.label: Codex
usageBackends.source: Read from Codex’s app server while an App Server agent works, and as a Terminal agent starts and after each turn (asking one of its own, which spends no usage), and so every 10 minutes while a hit limit holds its agents. On an API key, Codex has no usage windows: it reads nothing.
